_comment: CANONICAL custom-dashboard widget-type allowlist (Round 5 / G7; Round 14 SPEC §4.4.3 adds the built-in boards' modules). The SINGLE source of truth both the client widget registry (webui/src/soc/dashboard/registry.ts -> WIDGET_TYPES) and the server allowlist (backend/app/api/routes_dashboards.py -> WIDGET_TYPES) MUST equal. Two contract tests pin to this file and FAIL CI if either side drifts: webui dashboard-widget-types.contract.test.ts + backend test_round5_dashboards_widget_type_contract.py. Add a widget = add ONE value here + one registry entry + one lazy body + (only if a new rollup) one DashboardDataProvider source. See audit C1/H1.
